name.en: Ritmo Sand A-Line Cotton Maxi Dress with a Smart Casual Fit, Sleeveless Cut and a Full Skirt

description.en: A sand cotton maxi on an A-line, sleeveless, with a smart casual neckline. The skirt has enough body to walk in without clinging.
description.pt-BR: Longo evasê de algodão areia, sem manga, social leve. A saia tem corpo bastante para caminhar sem grudar.
